title: MemoryRecord
description: A single unit of memory owned by the Memory Service (ADR-0010). Qdrant stores the vector and this payload; it does not own the policy. Everything below the embedding is what distinguishes a memory system from a similarity index.

compatibility.notes: `embedding_model` is stored ON EVERY RECORD, not once globally, because that is what makes the ADR-0010 re-index migration possible: records embedded with the old model are identifiable and re-embeddable in place. Without per-record provenance an embedding change is unrecoverable data loss disguised as gradually worsening recall. Changing the kind enum is MAJOR — retention policy keys on it.

kind.description: Preserved from v1.0's two-collection split, plus `decision`. durable: never expires, curated. episodic: rolling window, decays. decision: an ADR indexed on merge per ADR-0016 — this is the mechanism that finally satisfies the project-memory rule that <thought> structurally could not.

trust_level.description: The trust of the content AT INGESTION. Recalling a memory reintroduces this level into the turn's TrustContext. A memory ingested from external_content stays external_content forever — laundering hostile content through memory must not upgrade it.

salience.description: Ingestion-policy score. Below the configured threshold the record is not stored at all — ADR-0010's ingestion policy is 'what is worth remembering', not 'store everything'.

importance.description: Retrieval-ranking weight, distinct from salience. Salience decides whether to keep it; importance decides how loudly it competes at recall.

expires_at.description: Null for durable and decision. Set for episodic from memory.episodic_ttl_days.

superseded_by.description: Record id that replaces this one. Consolidation sets this rather than deleting, so the trail survives.

redacted.description: ADR-0010's forget(id). A redacted record is excluded from retrieval and its text is cleared, but the tombstone remains so consolidation cannot resurrect it from a summary.

embedding_model.description: e.g. sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2. THE HIDDEN SCHEMA (ADR-0013). Per-record so re-indexing is possible.

source_record_ids.description: For consolidation output: which episodic records were summarised into this durable one.

examples.text: L.I.O.N.E.L uses a hybrid swappable brain adapter rather than a hardcoded LLM, so the local-vs-API tool-calling gap stays measurable.
